summary.content:
Today's selection covers 71 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 47 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Can These ChatGPT Ads Make You Love A.I.?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Silent Ransom Group targets law firms with fake IT support calls
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 11 articles published in the last 24 hours
